        return -np.sum(radii)
    
    def constraint_bounds(params):
        # Ensure all circles are within bounds
        x_coords = params[0::3]
        y_coords = params[1::3]
        radii = params[2::3]
        
        # Check each circle is within rectangle bounds
        bounds_check = []
        for i in range(n):
            # Circle center must be at least radius from edges
            bounds_check.append(x_coords[i] - radii[i] >= 0)
            bounds_check.append(y_coords[i] - radii[i] >= 0)
            bounds_check.append(x_coords[i] + radii[i] <= width)
            bounds_check.append(y_coords[i] + radii[i] <= height)
        return np.array(bounds_check)

        # Ensure no overlaps between circles
        x_coords = params[0::3]

                overlap_constraints.append(dist - min_dist)
